_**Agent (default)**_

From the repo root:

```powershell
uv run python wsgi.py
```

That binds Flask to **http://127.0.0.1:5000** with debug on.

Equivalent (matches `start.sh`):

```powershell
$env:LEAGUE_CACHE_WARM_ON_START="0"; uv run flask --app wsgi run --port 5000 --no-debug
```

Start it in your terminal, then tell me when it’s up and I’ll probe it. For federation-officials content we’ll aim the deck at decision-makers (coverage, trust, federation value), not player analytics.
